Creative worlds only. Searches outward from where you stand, as far as it takes.
Wildlife (animals, insects, floating petals and leaves)
Sky extras (rainbows, aurora, shooting stars, birds, balloons)
Screen polish (sun glare, vignette, colour grade)
Ray tracing look (not real ray tracing: real sun shadows on everything incl. grass and trees, plus sun light shafts. Low = 1024 shadow map, High = 2048)
Path tracing (experimental, heavy: real rays are cast through the terrain and rocks from the sun and the sky for soft shadows and ambient occlusion, baked into the ground. Low = 6 rays, High = 12)
Tree and plant style (Default = lighter branching trees, Realistic = full detail)
